'''Darth Pharov''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[third Galactic War]]. She participated and [[Death/Legends|died]] in the [[Invasion of Ossus]].<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Pharov first appeared in Patch 5.10.0 "Jedi Under Siege" of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a hostile NPC on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] side with the title "Imperial Commander".

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
